title: アドバンスドマニュファクチャリングⅡ
subtitle: Advanced Manufacturing II
keywords: Production processing 2.High value-added processing 3.Production system 4.Form Shaping 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Many of production machining technologies have names that indicate their purpose and characteristics. This lecture is positioned as an extension of "Manufacturing process and systems" and "Machining Engineering" to broaden the view of production machining technology and to understand its methods. In addition, students will learn about the production process to realize the manufacturing of products and parts. They will also learn about shape creation in various manufacturing processes.
advice: In this class, students will study the following topics. 1. Production Manufacturing, Process and Machine tools 2. Machine materials, Surface finishing and Coating 3. Deformation processing (Casting, Plastic molding) 4. Additive processing (Welding, Joining), Plasticity processing 5. Removal processing (Cutting, Grinding, Polishing) 6. Special machining (Electrical machining, Laser machining, Micro machining) 7. Additive manufacturing (Additive production) 8. Form Shaping Theory 9. Production System The class schedule may be changed to reflect on the above content with quizzes and exercises as appropriate.
books: Textbook:(1)はじめての生産加工学1 基本加工技術編[講談社]、(2)はじめての生産加工学2 応用加工技術編[講談社]
requiredKnowledge: As this is a practical study, it is recommended that students make use of videos on machining, machine tools, and production systems. In addition to the related videos that will be shown in class, they will also be useful in deepening the understanding of this lecture. It is also important to take advantage of opportunities such as visits to machining facilities and industrial exhibitions to observe and experience the actual machining process.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) To accurately explain the characteristics of materials used in machining. (2) To accurately explain suitable machining methods for various types of materials. (3) To accurately explain the various types of machining methods used in production processing technology. (4) To accurately explain the production process for manufacturing products and parts. (5) To accurately explain the theoretical analysis of machining methods that lead to the creation of shapes in manufacturing processes. The numbers (1) through (5) correspond to the student's action goals.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) To explain the characteristics of materials used in machining. (2) To explain suitable machining methods for various types of materials. (3) To explain the various types of machining methods used in production processing technology. (4) To explain the production process for manufacturing products and parts. (5) To explain the theoretical analysis of machining methods that lead to the creation of shapes in manufacturing processes. The numbers (1) through (5) correspond to the student's action goals.

lessons.content: Understand the learning objectives, outline and action goals of the subject based on the learning support plan. In particular, understand which part of the educational goals of the Department of Mechanical Engineering this subject is responsible for and the specific level of achievement. In addition, understand the lecture policy of this subject and the outline of (1) Production processing technology, Production process, and Machine tools to be studied in this subject.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Understand the relationship between the educational goals of the Department of Mechanical Engineering and this course. Understand the role of production and processing technology. Understand the production process. Read the textbook (1) pp.1-10 (Chapter 1 Introduction) to deepen understanding.

lessons.content: (2) Mechanical Materials: Students will learn about the basics of materials and processing. Students will write a self-assessment report at the end of the course.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A and A mini-test (1) will be given to check the understanding of the class content.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Read the textbook (2) pp.1-26 (Chapter 1 Materials and Processing) to deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: (2) Students will learn the basics of surface preparation and coating. At the end of the course, students will prepare a self-inspection report.
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A and A mini-test (2) will be given to check the understanding of the class content.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Read the textbook (2) pp.75-94 (Chapter 5 Surface Preparation and Coating) to deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: (3) Deformation processing: Students will learn about the basics of casting. At the end of the course, students will write a self-assessment report.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Read the textbook (1) pp.11-22 (Chapter 2 Casting) to deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: (3) Deformation processing: Students will learn the basics of plastic molding process. (4) Self-check report at the end.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A and A mini-test (3) will be given to check the understanding of the class content.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Read the textbook (1) pp. 23-39 (Chapter 3: Plastic Molding Process) to deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: (4) Additive Processing Students will learn about the basics of welding and joining. At the end of the course, students will prepare a self-inspection report.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Read the textbook (1) pp. 40-49 (Chapter 4: Welding and Joining) to deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: (4) Students will learn the basics of plastic forming. At the end of the course, students will write a self-assessment report.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A and A mini-test (4) will be given to check the understanding of the class content.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Read the textbook (1) pp. 50-73 (Chapter 5: Plasticity) to deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: (5) Students will learn the basics of removal processes (cutting, grinding, and polishing). Students will write a self-assessment report at the end of the course. An exam will be given as a mid-term review.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Read the textbook (1) pp. 74-129 (Chapter 6 Cutting Process, Chapter 7 Grinding Process, Chapter 8 Polishing Process) to deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: (6)Special Processing: Students will learn the basics of electrical processing. At the end of the course, students will write a self-assessment report.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Read the textbook (2) pp. 41-56 (Chapter 3: Electrical Processing) to deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: (6)Special Processing: Students will learn about the basics of laser processing. At the end of the course, students will write a self-assessment report.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Read the textbook (2) pp.57-74 (Chapter 4 Laser Processing) to deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: (6)Special Processing: Students will learn the basics of microfabrication. Students will write a self-assessment report at the end of the course.
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A and A mini-test (5) will be given to check the understanding of the class content.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Read the textbook (2) pp. 111-124 (Chapter 7 Microfabrication) to deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: (7) Students will learn the basics of additive manufacturing. At the end of the course, students will prepare a self-assessment report.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Read the textbook (2) pp. 95-110 (Chapter 6: Additive Manufacturing) to deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: (8) Students will learn the basics of shape creation theory. At the end of the course, students will write a self-assessment report.
lessons.assignments: [Review: Understand mathematical modeling of machine tools by homogeneous coordinate transformation.

lessons.content: (9) Students will learn about the basics of production systems. At the end of the course, students will prepare a self-assessment report.
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A and Examinations will be given on the contents of the first through 14th lessons in relation to the action objectives.
lessons.assignments: [Review]: Understand production systems that combine various processing technologies. Read the textbook (2) pp. 27-40 (Chapter 2: Production System and Die/Mold Processing) to deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: Students will learn about the advanced functions of machine tools. At the end of the course, students will prepare a self-inspection report. An examination will be given throughout the course.
lessons.operation: Explanation of the examination and question-and-answer session on the points that were not fully understood will be conducted for review and study.
lessons.assignments: [Preparation]: Review the class notes, textbook, etc. thoroughly in preparation for the written examination.
